# netactuate_cloud_base_images (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Base Images visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_base_images" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `base_images` (List of Object) Base images available for cloud server deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_images))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
